description.value: Prospect Point Bar & Grill occupies one of Stanley Park's most iconic viewpoints, perched above the Lions Gate Bridge with sweeping vistas of the North Shore Mountains and Burrard Inlet. Part of the Capilano Group's BC hospitality portfolio, the site has a documented cycling history — the Vancouver Bicycle Club was photographed here in 1895. Touring cyclists riding the Stanley Park Seawall can reach it via a short paved pathway connecting to Avison Trail.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 31m; rack at 34m; stands (10 spaces) at 35m. Total: 18 spaces.
